after.zh: 一个物体附近好几个位置都过了门槛，就会框出好几个重叠的框。非极大值抑制只留下周围最强的那一个：检测器的最后一步几乎都是它。
after.en: When several positions round one object pass the threshold, you get several overlapping boxes. Non-maximum suppression keeps only the strongest round about: it is almost always a detector's last step.

t.zh: 检测器会从多个位置报出候选框。同一物体可能被报多次：先保留高分候选，再看与它重叠的低分候选该不该留下。
t.en: A detector proposes boxes at many locations. Several candidates can report the same object. Keep the high-scoring candidate first, then decide which overlapping lower-scoring candidates should survive.

t.zh: 一只狗占好几个像素，附近好几个位置都像狗。检测器常常给同一只狗画出好几个框。
t.en: A dog covers several pixels, and several nearby positions all look like a dog. A detector often draws several boxes for one dog.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：每只狗只输出一个点。
t.en: Your task in this level: output a single point for each dog.

brief.zh: 照片里的狗是一团团亮斑，边有点糊。每只狗只输出一个点，在它正中间。
brief.en: The dogs in the photo are bright patches, a little blurred at the edges. Output a single point for each dog, at its very centre.

hint.zh: 3×3 平均在亮斑上的每一格都很大。
hint.en: A 3×3 average is large on every cell of a patch.
